Open House Reminder – This Saturday in Moody, TX! #openhouse 

Looking for land, space, and country serenity—but still want a home that’s move-in ready?
Join us this Saturday, August 2nd from 1 to 4 PM at 7731 Franklin Rd in Moody, TX for a chance to walk this stunning 10+ acre property in person.

Hosted by Kati Bennett, listed by Bill Vernon with the i35 Group.

🏞️ This one-of-a-kind property features:
– Room for horses, livestock, or a full homestead
– High-ground views and mature oaks
– A warm, inviting home with a sunroom, front porch, and spacious kitchen
– A stocked pond, barn, sheds, and RV hook-ups
– Privacy at the end of a quiet dead-end road

🔍 What makes a great country home in Central Texas?
Acreage, peace, functionality, and space to grow—just like this.

📍 7731 Franklin Rd, Moody, TX 76557
📲 Questions? Call or text Kati Bennett at 512.285.7724
Or email: kati@i35group.com

Come explore your next chapter—we’ll save you a seat on the porch.

i35 Group is a group of hard-working real estate agents always striving to get the best deal for our buyers and the most money for our sellers. We are neighborhood experts in Central Texas. Choose us for your real estate needs.
